title: AFL Grand Final
metaDescription: The AFL Grand Final decides the Australian rules football premiership at the Melbourne Cricket Ground

overview.about: The AFL Grand Final is the championship-deciding match of Australian rules football and one of the biggest days on the Australian sporting calendar. Held on the last Saturday of September at the Melbourne Cricket Ground before a 100,000 crowd, it crowns the season's premiers. Carlton, Collingwood and Essendon share the record with 16 premierships each.
overview.nextEvent: The next AFL Grand Final is played at the MCG in Melbourne, the culmination of the finals series between the competition's two best clubs. It is a public holiday in Victoria, with a pre-match entertainment tradition all its own.
